title: [GMCP 203.046.06] Operations and evidence: Property testing, fuzzing, model checking, and continuous red-team
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-046-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: All parsers, serializers, state machines, URI/schema evaluators, policy decisions and transport boundaries have invariant/property tests and coverage-guided fuzz targets with retained regression seeds. Lifecycle, task and subscription models are checked for safety/liveness; threat-model abuse cases map to automated adversarial tests; sanitizer and red-team campaigns report zero unresolved critical/high findings at release. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
